youtube.title: Napoleon paid 12,000 francs to invent canned food 🥫 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon Bonaparte basically funded canned food 🥫

Would you eat 200-year-old army soup? Yes or no 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: France offered a 12,000-franc prize for a way to preserve food for its armies. Confectioner Nicolas Appert won it in 1810 under Napoleon by sealing food in glass jars and boiling them. Two years later Napoleon invaded Russia anyway, and supply problems helped destroy his army.
